name: Vishal Jethwa
bio: Vishal Jethwa is an Indian television actor. He is best known for portraying Akbar on Bharat Ka Veer Putra – Maharana Pratap which aired on Sony TV and Sunny in the Hindi-language film Mardaani 2.  Source - Wikipedia
